faq.q: What is Seal of Leonida in GTA 6?
faq.a: Seal of Leonida is an in-game media title listed for GTA 6 on the GTA Fandom wiki. The wiki entry is the only record of it. Rockstar has not named it in a trailer, a press release or on the Grand Theft Auto VI site, so this page records the wiki listing and marks it as a community source.

faq.q: Is Seal of Leonida confirmed for GTA 6?
faq.a: No. A Fandom wiki page is written by fans, not by Rockstar. This site files Seal of Leonida as community identified, at low confidence, for that reason. The entry stays at low confidence until Rockstar or a major outlet names it.

faq.q: What does the wiki say about Seal of Leonida?
faq.a: The wiki gives 1 detail. Type: seal. Those are wiki fields copied as they stand. No figure here was measured in the game, because the game has not released.

faq.q: Where does this Seal of Leonida information come from?
faq.a: From the GTA Fandom wiki page for Seal of Leonida, collected by the outlawdb project on 2026-09-13 and released under CC BY-SA 3.0. The source link on this page opens the wiki page itself, so you can read the same entry.

faq.q: What is still unknown about Seal of Leonida?
faq.a: Most of it. Seal of Leonida rests on a fan wiki listing and nothing else. Whether it can be watched or read in game and how long it runs are both unpublished. Rockstar answers questions like this at launch, not before, so this page will change when it does.

faq.q: Will Seal of Leonida be in the finished GTA 6?
faq.a: Not known. A wiki listing is a claim by a fan editor, not a Rockstar statement. Plenty of in-game media title entries written before a launch never appear in the game. This site records the claim and the source, and marks the entry unconfirmed until that changes.
